description: Two polyphonic utilities on one panel: one multiplies a voltage by a settable amount, the other adds a settable voltage to it. Each takes CV over its setting

params.text: The amount the SCALE section multiplies its input by
Scales the CV modulating the SCALE amount
The voltage the OFFSET section adds to its input
Scales the CV modulating the OFFSET voltage

inputs.text: The voltage that is multiplied by the SCALE amount
A CV modulating the SCALE amount
The voltage the OFFSET voltage is added to
A CV modulating the OFFSET voltage

outputs.text: The SCALE section's input multiplied by the SCALE amount
The OFFSET section's input with the OFFSET voltage added

menu: Snap values to 0.1 — makes the SCALE and OFFSET settings move in steps of 0.1 instead of continuously
